name: Elena Rodriguez Vega
bio:
Elena Rodriguez Vega's journey into the world of motorsport PR was somewhat accidental, beginning with a summer internship at a local racing circuit in Valencia. She quickly discovered a knack for crafting narratives and managing public perception, turning what was meant to be a temporary job into a full-fledged career. Her sharp communication skills and ability to remain composed under pressure quickly led to climbing the ladder, securing roles with smaller racing teams before ultimately landing at Mercedes-AMG. 

Elena is known for her meticulously planned press strategies and her unwavering focus on building a positive brand image. She believes in proactive communication and anticipates potential issues before they arise. Elena's demanding nature stems from her commitment to excellence and her understanding of the high stakes involved in maintaining a top team's reputation. She is known for her ability to get the best out of her team, pushing them to achieve extraordinary results through her clear expectations and unwavering belief in their abilities.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a neat bun or ponytail.
physical.description: Elena is a slender woman with a focused gaze and an elegant, professional demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even during meetings.
Insists on having a specific brand of Spanish coffee every morning.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
